exact_subtraction_algebra.scope: Full 111-field matrix identities for arbitrary local coefficients. Exact linear BRST subtraction does not force its equation remainder to vanish; no actual parametrix coefficient is simulated.

same_potential_source_and_gauge_fixing.scope: Original five-scalar potential and SU(2) generators in a zero-dimensional Gaussian calibration, with a declared auxiliary gauge matrix. This is neither the physical Hadamard covariance nor a continuum loop computation.

scope: The same linear BRST extension admits a locally constructed subtraction with exact free BRST identities. The finite same-state all-sector tadpole candidate and background quadratic insertion agree at this level. The remaining on-shell Ward defect is a local equation-remainder trace, not proven to vanish or to have a permitted local primitive. Interacting Ward identities, absolute conserved backreaction and actual instruments remain open.
